title: wedelia macrorrhiza
intro: Wedelia macrorrhiza, commonly known as Country Mallow, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to tropical and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia macrorrhiza include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can reduce pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
